promote_only_if_all: locked holdout (Liquicity + Hospital Records corpus mixes): grouped-bootstrap 95% CI of mean exit+cue bar error delta vs default lies entirely below 0
fresh-mix test: same delta not worse (point estimate <= 0)
hard checks: no more hard-fail pairs than default on dev + holdout + fresh (pairs where default already fails are not counted against it)
style_setting variants additionally need a real per-mix style setting from the listener; until then they stay flags
note: Similarity score is diagnostic only. the listener's A/B is an optional low-weight taste signal, not a gate. rules.json is never edited by this workstream.
